[S1394]. Additionally, Cumulative four-chapter philosophical-lens summary mapping to architectural questions: Ch.1 DecisionUnderConflict, Ch.2 Identity+Continuity, Ch.3 Knowledge->Action, Ch.4 Transmission+Lineage+Authority -- explicitly framed as philosophical lenses, not software specifications, that repeatedly expose the model's needed distinctions [S1394]. Further, Step 191 verdict: the constitutional kernel should intercept and validate only transitions crossing declared semantic boundaries, not model all system activity -- 'KnowledgeOS Kernel = Semantic Transition Assurance', explicitly rejecting an all-encompassing 'KnowledgeOS = Everything' framing [S1394].
